limitations: The meaning of robustly and the treatment of successors remain interpretive.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's voice assistant demo will never work robustly as advertised.

statement.excerpt: And of course I daresay the demo was just a demo, one that will never work robustly as advertised, but that too is a story for another day.

from_speaker: the demo was just a demo
will never work robustly as advertised
our_interpretation: The target is the voice assistant demonstrated in May 2024, including shipped versions and direct successors.
The ordinary reading of robustly is dependable performance in ordinary use, allowing occasional errors. It does not mean perfection.
As advertised refers to the demonstrated combination of responsive conversation, interruptions, expressive speech, translation, and interaction with visual inputs.
No numerical reliability threshold or deadline was supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that dependable delivery of the advertised capabilities is permanently impossible. Failures or delays over a finite period cannot establish never.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Repeatable public testing establishes that a shipped version reliably delivers the material advertised capabilities under ordinary conditions.

evidence.excerpt: We’re announcing GPT‑4o, our new flagship model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time.
evidence.explanation: The announcement establishes the multimodal scope and includes demonstrations of translation, expressive speech, and visual interaction. It does not establish repeatable reliability.

evidence.excerpt: Additionally, rare hallucinations in Voice Mode persist with this update, resulting in unintended sounds resembling ads, gibberish, or background music.
evidence.locator: June 7, 2025 — Updates to Advanced Voice Mode for paid users — Known Limitations
evidence.explanation: OpenAI acknowledged continuing failures in this version. Their existence does not establish permanent inability, and the source supplies no failure rate for the advertised tasks.

evidence.excerpt: GPT‑Live is built on a full-duplex architecture, meaning it can listen and speak at the same time.
evidence.explanation: This successor is relevant to the possibility that the forecast has been falsified. The manufacturer's description alone does not meet the independent reliability requirement.

evidence.excerpt: And, if you trail off to think, it actually waits for you instead of cutting you off.
evidence.explanation: The firsthand review reports successful pause handling and continuous translation of a recorded sports broadcast. These successes weigh against a sweeping dismissal but do not measure reliability across the full advertised scope.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Independent, repeated testing showing dependable performance across the advertised capability set would contradict the forecast. Supporting never would require evidence of permanent impossibility, not continuing failures.
